$comment: Mission events (4.6). Effects are declarative; sim/events.js applies them. Fairness rule: every outcome must be explainable by visible numbers.

events.name: Solar flare
events.intro: Solar flare inbound. The sun spits a wall of charged particles at the orbit.

choices.outcome: The spacecraft sleeps through the flare. A whole day of coverage is gone, but every part is intact.
choices.log: Went dark for the flare. Woke up grumpy but whole.

choices.outcome: The imaging computer took a hit. Part of today's data is corrupt.
choices.log: Rode out the flare. The memory banks will remember this.

events.name: Ground station rain-out
events.intro: Monsoon squall over the ground station. The dish cannot see the satellite.

choices.outcome: Data stays aboard. Half the usual downlink today.
choices.log: Rain ate the dish's view. Data waited its turn.

choices.outcome: The partner dish in another country takes the pass. Full downlink, extra spend.
choices.log: Borrowed a friend's dish. Worth every borrowed taka.

events.name: Buffer nearly full
events.intro: Onboard storage is nearly full. New images will overwrite the old.

choices.outcome: Housekeeping frames dumped. The important science stays.
choices.log: Threw away what I did not need. Storage: breathing room.

choices.outcome: No new images today, but nothing is lost.
choices.log: Camera off. I counted the clouds from memory.

events.name: Battery stress
events.intro: The battery ran deeper than design limits last night. The cells are cold and tired.

choices.outcome: Everything runs at half duty. Less science today, healthier battery.
choices.log: Ran on half rations. The cells thank me.

choices.outcome: Full science day, but the battery took permanent damage to its capacity.
choices.log: Pushed through. My battery will never be the same.

events.name: Star tracker glitch
events.intro: The star tracker lost lock. Pointing is wobbling.

choices.outcome: Pointing restored. One pass lost while it rebooted.
choices.log: Rebooted my own eyes. The stars lined up again.

choices.outcome: Half of today's images are smeared. Analysts can still use some.
choices.log: The stars smeared. So did my photographs.

events.name: Secretary Alam calls
events.intro: "The minister is asking when we will have pictures. What do I tell him?"

choices.outcome: Alam is quiet, then: "Good. I will manage expectations."
choices.log: Told the truth upstairs. It cost a little now, bought a lot later.

choices.outcome: Alam promises the moon. The control room exchange a look.
choices.log: The director promised miracles. I just make pictures.
